newsitem.title: CHINA: PRESS DIGEST - Shanghai newspapers - May 20.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Shanghai newspapers - May 20.

text.p: Following is a summary of major political and business stories in local newspapers, prepared by Reuters in Shanghai. Reuters has not checked the stories and does not guarantee their accuracy.

- SHANGHAI SECURITIES NEWS - Statistics show bank deposits are still the most important investment channel for individuals with national bank deposits hitting 4.15 trillion yuan at the end of March, a rise of 23.7 percent against the 1996 period.
- Commentary urges tough measures against excessive speculation, warning that recent rises on the stock markets have partly been a result of speculation in stocks of poorly-performing firms.
- BUSINESS NEWS - Shanghai machinery exports hit $1.286 billion in the first four months, an increase of 56.4 percent against the same 1996 period.
- Experts urge protection of national industries while allowing set-up of a growing number of Sino-foreign joint ventures.
